bootstrap.equal_game_means: descriptive, excludes games with zero target states in that stratum

limitations: Exposed held-out-state diagnostic, not independent fresh confirmation
Mode-action choices only; no sampled-policy simulation
One action, no new autonomous game or continuation
No training, architecture change, new teacher labels or world-model work
Immediate score or blind-clear benefit does not establish full long-horizon generalization
Every policy, stratum and fixed contrast reported even if null or negative
verification_scope: Independently recomputed saved-row aggregates, prediction identity and immutable hashes; simulator parity asserted by worker. No independent rerun of model, teacher or simulator.
